title: Victoria Deserves Real Safety — Sign the Petition
lede: Repeat offenders walking out on bail. Aggravated burglaries climbing year on year. Victoria carrying the burden. Sign the petition demanding the Victorian Parliament put law-abiding families ahead of recidivists.
photoCaption: PHOTO HERE — Moira · Caroline Springs community safety event

argument.lede: Home invasions, carjackings, and youth crime are tearing through suburbs that used to be safe. The Government promises reviews. The Opposition promises statements. I am taking the fight directly to the Parliament — and I need your name on the petition to do it.
argument.body: Your signature is filed publicly with my office and tabled in the Legislative Council under the Council's Petition Standing Orders. It is the most direct way constituents have to put pressure on the Premier to act.
argument.quote: The first job of a State Government is the safety of its own people. Right now, on every measure that matters, Victoria is failing the people of the West.
argument.planHeading: What I'm asking the Parliament to do
plan: Mandatory minimum sentences for repeat violent offences and weapons offences.
End the bail-and-release loop for serious recidivists — restore the presumption against bail for repeat indictable offending.
Fund 500 additional frontline officers across Victoria, with deployment audited annually.
Statutory right of victims to be notified and heard at every bail and sentencing decision.
Independent review of every juvenile bail decision granted in 2024–25, with findings tabled.

petition.lede: To the Legislative Council of Victoria — restore real consequences for repeat offenders, fund frontline policing, and put community safety first.
